title: Tahini Wrap
description: A simple and delicious wrap filled with creamy tahini sauce, fresh herbs, and crunchy vegetables. Perfect for a quick and easy snack or light meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together tahini, garlic, and cumin until smooth.
Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.
Add the tahini mixture to the skillet and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Warm the wrap in the microwave or in a dry skillet for 10-15 seconds.
Spread the tahini sauce on the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add any additional toppings you like, such as sliced veggies or herbs.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap tightly.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
